question: Which of the following commands participated in the successful combat launch of the BrahMos Supersonic Cruise Missile by the Indian Army in December 2025 from a test range in the Bay of Bengal?
solution:
p>The correct answer is __**Southern Command**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **December 2025**, the **Indian Army** successfully conducted a combat launch of the **BrahMos Supersonic Cruise Missile** from a test range located in the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• The successful launch was executed by the **Southern Command** of the Indian Army, demonstrating the high state of operational readiness and the precision strike capabilities of the missile system.
 
• The missile followed a pre-defined trajectory and successfully hit its designated target ship with pinpoint accuracy, validating the tactical procedures for long-range engagement.
 
• This test was part of a series of training exercises aimed at ensuring that the **Indian Army** remains prepared for multi-domain warfare and maritime security challenges.
